product_overview: NagarDrishti is a mobile-first civic issue platform that helps residents report neighborhood problems, discover and support nearby existing reports, and verify whether claimed fixes were actually completed. It also provides a public transparency layer and a mock officer workflow to make civic action visible through an auditable issue lifecycle.
core_goals: Help citizens report civic issues quickly with photo, location, and description.
Help citizens find and support nearby duplicate or similar issues instead of filing repeats.
Make issue status, timelines, and proof of fix visible to the public in a privacy-preserving way.
Let officers triage issues, update status, and submit proof of claimed resolution.
Allow citizens to verify claimed fixes and reopen issues when they are not actually resolved.
Expose ward and department performance through public scorecards and breach views.

features.name: Report Civic Issue
features.description: Citizens create a new civic complaint with media, approximate location, a description, and category guidance before submitting it for tracking.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen/report -> Upload a photo -> Allow approximate location access -> Provide a text description -> Review the AI category suggestion -> Accept or correct the suggested category -> Submit the report -> See the issue confirmation and tracking details

Navigate to /citizen/report -> Upload a photo -> Provide a text description -> Review the AI category suggestion -> Select a different category -> Submit the report -> See the created issue with the chosen category

features.name: Support Nearby Existing Issue
features.description: Citizens can discover nearby active complaints and support an existing one so repeated reports are consolidated into a shared public demand signal.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen -> Open the nearby issues view -> Review nearby issue summaries and support counts -> Choose an issue that matches the same problem -> Support the issue -> See the supporter count increase and the issue remain tracked as a shared report

Navigate to /citizen/report -> Review nearby duplicate suggestions -> Choose to support an existing nearby issue instead of creating a new report -> Confirm the support action -> See the selected issue added to the user's supported items

features.name: View Citizen Issue Timeline
features.description: Citizens can open their reported issue to follow its public lifecycle, including status changes, supporting activity, and proof-related updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen -> Open one of the user's reported issues -> Review the status timeline and supporting activity -> Observe the current workflow state and any proof or verification prompts
Navigate to /citizen/issue/:id -> Review the issue details -> Inspect the timeline of status changes -> Observe any public evidence or progress updates

features.name: Verify Claimed Fix
features.description: After an officer claims a resolution, citizens can review before-and-after evidence and vote on whether the issue is actually fixed.
user_flows: Navigate to /citizen/issue/:id/verify -> Review before and after photos -> Select fixed -> Submit the verification vote -> See the updated vote count and issue status

Navigate to /citizen/issue/:id/verify -> Review before and after photos -> Select not fixed -> Submit the verification vote -> See the issue move toward reopened status when enough nearby negative votes are collected
Navigate to /citizen/issue/:id/verify -> Review before and after photos -> Select unsure -> Submit the verification vote -> See the vote recorded without claiming certainty

features.name: Review Public Transparency Map and Scorecards
features.description: Public visitors can inspect privacy-preserving issue locations, redacted issue details, SLA breach feeds, and ward or department performance snapshots.
user_flows: Navigate to /transparency -> Review the public issue map -> Filter by ward, category, or status -> Inspect privacy-coarsened issue markers and counts -> Open a redacted issue detail -> Review the public timeline and redacted media

Navigate to /transparency -> Review ward and department scorecards -> Inspect SLA compliance and median resolution time -> Review the SLA breach wall -> Open forgotten issues to see the oldest and most neglected public items

features.name: Officer Triage and Status Management
features.description: Mock officers can assign themselves, progress issues through the lifecycle, mark them as claimed resolved, and attach proof of work.
user_flows: Navigate to /officer/queue -> Review the triage queue -> Open an issue that needs action -> Assign the issue to the current officer -> Progress the workflow -> Claim the issue as resolved after work is completed -> Upload proof photo and add a note -> See the issue move to claimed resolved

Navigate to /officer/issue/:id -> Review the issue details and similar issues -> Assign the issue -> Update its status to in progress -> Upload proof of fix -> Observe the resulting claimed resolved state and appended timeline event

features.name: Report Civic Issue

user_interactions: Review and accept AI category suggestion

features.name: Vote on Claimed Fix
features.description: Citizen casts verification vote on officer's claimed resolution
user_interactions: Click Yes fixed, Not fixed, or Unsure
View updated vote count and status

user_interactions: Review ward and department SLA compliance
